mapper.select: SELECT a.skill_id, a.tenant_id, a.skill_name, a.skill_code, a.catalog_item_id, a.file_info_id, a.data_from, a.created_time, a.status_cd, a.updated_time, a.creator_id, a.updator_id, a.remark, b.file_id, c.file_name, c.file_size, a.skill_square_id, a.skill_version, a.skill_type, a.skill_template_type, a.skill_file_name, a.skill_ext_json FROM bt_agent_skill a LEFT JOIN bt_file_info b ON b.file_info_id = a.file_info_id AND b.tenant_id = a.tenant_id AND b.status_cd = '00A' LEFT JOIN bt_file c ON c.file_id = b.file_id AND c.status_cd = '00A' WHERE a.status_cd = '00A' AND a.skill_id = #{skillId} AND a.tenant_id in(#{tenantId}, -1)
